verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents an embeddable feedback widget with a write-only widget key and project routing. No evidence shows a way to identify logged-in users or attach submissions to their existing accounts, such as an identify call, user metadata, or SSO-linked identity. The axis applies to a feedback-capture product, so the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can identify logged-in users when they submit feedback so it ties to their existing account
